acceptance: Official independent verifier; complete-task acceptance primary, partial items diagnostic. Existing tasks are seen regressions, not unseen generalization.
adoption: Compare complete-task acceptance and preserved existing behavior first. Report all-attempt token movement even on failures, but claim efficiency only for comparable both-complete work. Same acceptance with higher tokens does not pass performance gate. No general superiority claim from four paired observations.
limits: Two seen regression tasks, two repeats per arm. Bounded diagnostic comparison, not full DeepSWE score or unseen generalization. All attempts retained; no automatic retry. No provider seed control available.
commonHarnessChanges: Both arms: request timeout 90s to 300s; relay socket timeout 315s; export artifacts in tea-export subdirectory to avoid Pier manifest collision. No production source changes. Previous incomplete run retained separately, not pooled.
